branch: tool_result (async agent launch) + system/task_notification carrying the harness envelope
provenance: Both payloads are VERBATIM from the CLI binary (2.1.226, ~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.226), not inferred from our handlers: the launch text is the `status==="async_launched"` branch of the agent tool's mapToolResultToToolResultBlockParam, and the envelope is the template built by `hVd()` from the `y8_` prefix. Sub-agent task frames are LIVE-ONLY and never persisted, so no transcript can supply them and this fixture is the only regression pin. The frame WRAPPERS (task_started/task_notification field names) come from 01-subagent-task-lifecycle, whose own provenance covers them.
